title: Auspicate

inlines.v: AU'SPICATE, verb transitive [Latin asupicor.] 1. To give a favorable turn to; a sense taken from the Roman practice of taking the auspicium, or inspection of birds, before they undertook any important business. 2. To foreshow. 3. To begin.
